objs.name: document
objs.description: Core managed artifact representing policies, guidelines, procedural instructions, or work instructions, subject to creation, editing, release, versioning, distribution, and archiving.

attributes.name: document_type
attributes.description: Classification of the document (e.g. policy, guideline, procedural instruction, work instruction).

attributes.name: document_abbreviation
attributes.description: Type-based abbreviation with consecutive number identifying the document.

attributes.name: version
attributes.description: Current version number of the document.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the document (e.g. editing, released, out of force, archived).

attributes.name: valid_from
attributes.description: Date from which the released version of the document is valid.

attributes.name: valid_until
attributes.description: Date until which the document remains valid, calculated from Valid From plus validity period.

attributes.name: scope
attributes.description: Applicability scope of the document.

attributes.name: references
attributes.description: Links to other documents, master data, or related objects.

attributes.name: it_applications
attributes.description: Referenced IT applications associated with the document.

attributes.name: relevant_companies
attributes.description: Companies or areas of validity for which the document applies.

attributes.name: archive_duration
attributes.description: Period the document is retained after invalidation before physical deletion (default 10 years).

attributes.name: validity_period
attributes.description: Default period for validity extension check (default 3 years).

attributes.name: language
attributes.description: Original language of the document content.

attributes.name: client_visibility
attributes.description: Clients in which the document is visible in a multi-client system.

objs.name: attachment
objs.description: Controlled sub-document linked to a main document, subject to its own versioning and released together with the main document.

attributes.name: version
attributes.description: Current version number of the attachment.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the attachment.

objs.name: additional_info
objs.description: Supplementary non-controlled information object linked to a document, not subject to a release cycle.

attributes.name: published
attributes.description: Whether the additional info is published via property switches.

objs.name: change_proposal
objs.description: A formal request proposing changes to an existing released document, managed independently of the document version.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Current status of the change proposal (e.g. created, scheduled, completed).

objs.name: validity_extension_request
objs.description: System-generated request triggered 30 days before document validity expires, requiring workflow-supported processing.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Current processing status of the validity extension request.

objs.name: override_request
objs.description: Request to invalidate a document and archive it, initiating the out-of-force process.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Current processing status of the override request.

objs.name: reactivation_request
objs.description: Request to reactivate a previously invalidated and archived document.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Current processing status of the reactivation request.

objs.name: user
objs.description: An individual person who participates in document management processes in various roles.

attributes.name: role
attributes.description: System role assigned to the user (e.g. reader, author, reviewer, releaser, translator).

objs.name: user_group
objs.description: A named group of users used for authorization and distribution assignment.

attributes.name: group_name
attributes.description: Name identifying the user group (e.g. Reader - Document Management, Archive).

objs.name: workflow
objs.description: A structured approval or processing flow consisting of sequential steps with assigned participants.

attributes.name: workflow_type
attributes.description: Type of workflow (e.g. release, validity extension, override, reactivation, acknowledgement).

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Current status of the workflow instance.

objs.name: electronic_signature
objs.description: A digital signature applied by a workflow participant to confirm completion of a workflow step.

attributes.name: signer
attributes.description: Identity of the person who signed.

attributes.name: timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time the signature was applied.

objs.name: distribution_list
objs.description: List of user groups and persons assigned to receive a document via email notification or acknowledgement upon release.

attributes.name: distribution_type
attributes.description: Type of distribution: by email or for acknowledgement.

objs.name: document_template
objs.description: A predefined template associated with a document type, used when creating new documents.

attributes.name: format
attributes.description: Source format of the template (e.g. Word, Excel, PowerPoint).

objs.name: organizational_unit
objs.description: A business unit or department to which documents can be linked.

objs.name: process
objs.description: A business process to which documents can be linked for process-specific filing.

evts.name: create_document
evts.description: A new document is created in the system by attaching a new information object with a selected document type and optional template.

attributes.name: document_type_selected
attributes.description: The document type chosen during creation.

evts.name: edit_document_content
evts.description: The content of a document is modified using the integrated editing client in the corresponding Office application.

evts.name: edit_document_properties
evts.description: Metadata and attributes of a document are maintained or updated in the properties dialog.

evts.name: convert_document_to_pdf
evts.description: After saving, the document is automatically converted to PDF for web display.

evts.name: start_release_workflow
evts.description: The 3-step release workflow (Creator-Review-Release) is initiated by the author or a co-author.

evts.name: sign_as_author
evts.description: The registered author signs the document in the first Creator step of the release workflow.

evts.name: review_document
evts.description: A reviewer checks the document for technical and/or formal correctness during the review step.

evts.name: release_document
evts.description: A releaser approves the document for distribution to readers, completing the release workflow.

evts.name: reject_document
evts.description: A reviewer or releaser rejects the document during the workflow, canceling subsequent steps.

attributes.name: rejection_reason
attributes.description: Reason provided for the rejection.

evts.name: publish_document
evts.description: After release, the document is automatically published and becomes visible to addressed readers.

evts.name: create_new_version
evts.description: A new editing version of a released document is created for revision purposes.

evts.name: add_attachment
evts.description: A controlled attachment is added to a document, triggering a new version of the main document.

evts.name: modify_attachment
evts.description: An existing attachment is modified, triggering a new version of the main document.

evts.name: archive_attachment
evts.description: An attachment is marked for archiving and archived upon release of the next main document version.

evts.name: add_additional_info
evts.description: A non-controlled additional information object is added to a document.

evts.name: create_change_proposal
evts.description: A change proposal is created for an existing released document without affecting its content or version.

evts.name: schedule_change_proposal
evts.description: A change proposal is scheduled for implementation, creating a new version of the document.

evts.name: complete_change_proposal
evts.description: The author documents the editing of a change proposal, marking it as completed.

evts.name: create_validity_extension_request
evts.description: The system automatically creates a validity extension request 30 days before the document validity expires.

evts.name: extend_validity
evts.description: The releaser (or release team) confirms additional validity, updating the Valid Until date.

evts.name: create_override_request
evts.description: A user with write access creates a request to invalidate and archive a document.

evts.name: approve_override
evts.description: The override request is approved, setting the document status to out of force and revoking authorizations.

evts.name: create_reactivation_request
evts.description: A Business Admin group member creates a request to reactivate an archived document.

evts.name: confirm_reactivation
evts.description: The initiator confirms reactivation, creating a new version of the document with restored metadata and authorizations.

evts.name: distribute_by_email
evts.description: Users on the distribution list are notified by email upon release of a new document version.

evts.name: distribute_for_acknowledgement
evts.description: Users on the distribution list are requested to actively confirm acknowledgement of the released document.

evts.name: confirm_acknowledgement
evts.description: A recipient confirms acknowledgement of a document via a workflow task.

evts.name: assign_authorization
evts.description: Read or write authorizations are assigned to user groups or persons for a document.

evts.name: translate_document
evts.description: Released document content is translated into another language.

attributes.name: target_language
attributes.description: Language into which the document is translated.

evts.name: release_translation
evts.description: A translated document version is checked and released via workflow, making it visible in the corresponding login language.

evts.name: reactivate_attachment
evts.description: Attachments archived with an invalidated document are reactivated during the document reactivation process.

evts.name: physically_delete_document
evts.description: After the archive period expires, the archived document is physically deleted from the system.

o2o.description: An Attachment is a controlled sub-document belonging to a specific main Document.
An Additional Info object is supplementary information belonging to a specific Document.
A Change Proposal is associated with a specific Document it proposes to change.
A Validity Extension Request is linked to the Document whose validity it checks.
An Override Request is created for a specific Document to initiate invalidation.
A Reactivation Request references a specific archived Document for reactivation.
A Document Template is defined for a document type and used when creating new Documents.
A Document can reference another Document via the References attribute.
A Document can be linked to a Process for process-specific filing.
A Document can be linked to an Organizational Unit.
A Distribution List is maintained per Document to define its distribution recipients.
A Distribution List contains User Groups whose members receive the document.
A User is assigned to one or more User Groups for authorization and distribution.
